title: Digi-Dan
summary: A retrieval-augmented backend for a portfolio assistant that answers questions from curated profile, education, project, skill, and experience data instead of improvising.

images.alt: Digi-Dan chat panel answering a portfolio question with source citations
images.caption: Digi-Dan as presented in its portfolio chat interface.

sections.title: Grounded portfolio conversations
sections.summary: The backend supplies retrieval-grounded answers to a portfolio chat experience.

image.alt: Digi-Dan chat panel answering a portfolio question with source citations
image.caption: Portfolio chat interface powered by Digi-Dan.

problem: Portfolio visitors may ask open-ended questions that static pages cannot anticipate. The assistant needed to answer from approved material without exposing credentials or falling back to generic, ungrounded chat.
purpose: Create a deployable API that retrieves the most relevant curated knowledge-base chunks, supplies them to a generation provider as bounded context, and returns the answer with its source records.
keyFeatures: Retrieval-augmented chat over structured JSON, JSONL, and text knowledge-base content.
Gemini embeddings for retrieval, with Gemini or DeepSeek selectable for answer generation.
Answer payloads that include the matched source records for transparent review and debugging.
A Bearer-protected ingestion endpoint alongside a CLI uploader for vector data.
Allowed-origin checks, a trusted server-to-server bypass, and per-client chat rate limiting.
A Vercel-compatible FastAPI deployment path with GitHub Actions automation for RAG-data uploads.
role: Led the RAG backend build and portfolio-assistant integration across retrieval and generation, ingestion tooling, security boundaries, and the local-to-Vercel deployment path.
technicalHighlights: Uses Gemini embeddings to turn each question into a vector query, retrieve the most relevant Upstash Vector chunks, and assemble a character-bounded context before generation.
Separates provider concerns: Gemini or DeepSeek can generate the answer while the retrieval pipeline retains one embedding and vector-index contract.
Returns the answer, selected provider, and retrieved source records in one response so the portfolio interface can inspect its grounding.
Supports two ingestion paths: a validated, admin-protected API route and a CLI uploader for JSON, JSONL, or plain-text documents.
Separates public browser access from trusted callers with allowed-origin middleware, an X-API-Secret server bypass, a separate Bearer token for ingestion, and per-client chat rate limiting.
Runs locally with Uvicorn and deploys on Vercel through a compatible ASGI entrypoint and an Actions-based data-upload workflow.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: The assistant needs to handle broad natural-language questions without treating general model output as a reliable account of someone's work.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Retrieves focused, approved chunks before generation, caps the context passed to the model, and returns matched source records so the calling interface can review the grounding.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: The public chat experience needs API access, while ingestion and trusted server calls cannot expose administrative or bypass secrets in browser code.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Enforces configured browser origins, reserves X-API-Secret for trusted server-to-server calls, protects ingestion with a separate Bearer token, and limits chat requests by client.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Portfolio content changes over time, and manually keeping the vector index current would make the assistant stale or fragile.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Provides a reusable CLI uploader and GitHub Actions workflow that uploads RAG data when relevant data or ingestion code changes on main.

resultsImpact: Gives the portfolio a practical way to answer questions beyond fixed page copy while keeping conversations anchored to curated material.
Carries retrieved source records with every chat response, giving the consuming interface a clear basis for review, troubleshooting, and future presentation choices.

Establishes a reusable, deployment-ready pattern for a portfolio assistant, resume chatbot, documentation assistant, or small knowledge-base chatbot without relying on unverified performance or adoption metrics.
lessonsLearned: Retrieval quality starts with the knowledge base: clear chunk wording, focused topics, and dedicated summaries make broad questions easier to answer.
Multiple answer providers are useful, but they do not replace a stable embedding model, index dimension, and retrieval contract.
Source visibility is part of the product experience, not only a debugging aid; returning sources makes grounded behavior easier to inspect.
Secrets and privileged ingestion belong on trusted server or automation paths rather than in browser code.
